conversion adds PE, and C1 is set exactly when the stored magnitude is one.

sticky flags under the existing `0x80c0` FSW mask and preserve C0/C2/C3. Keep
the FCW whitelist, full canonical48 Dword preflight, one write/no read,
write-before-commit ordering, source payload preservation and FIST/FISTP TOP
rules. m16/m64, pseudo-denormals, malformed/tag-mismatched inputs and unmasked
delivery remain unsupported.

Cover four literal fraction payloads, both signs, all RC values/opcodes/TOPs,
64 incoming sticky-flag combinations and both old C1 values (65,536 cases),
plus FLD m80 composition, invalid classes/tags, write/range atomicity,
FNSTSW/FNCLEX composition, literal CLI observation and JIT/native denial. This local
extension does not complete S2-31 or ISSUE-019. See the
[CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#local-s2-31cq-canonical-subnormal-m32-fist),
[report](../reports/STAGE_2_REPORT.md#s2-31cq--canonical-subnormal-m32-fist),
and [fixture notes](../../tests/fixtures/x86/stage2/README.md).

## S2-31do — canonical binary80 subnormal through bounded FRNDINT

For Long64 bare `D9 FC`, admit only a Special-tagged old physical ST(0) whose
raw encoding is a canonical nonzero binary80 subnormal (biased exponent zero,
J=0, nonzero fraction). Preserve existing pseudo-denormal, malformed, class,
tag, control and status rejection boundaries. All admitted magnitudes are
below one-half: RN/RZ yield signed zero; RD yields -1 for negative and +0 for
positive; RU yields +1 for positive and -0 for negative. Each operation adds
sticky DE and PE, with C1 set only for ±1. Zero results become Zero-tagged;
one results become Valid-tagged. Preserve C0/C2/C3, TOP, unrelated state,
metadata and the existing all-masked/status gates. Propagate current DE only
through the local FRNDINT preflight/commit tuple.

Add an independent min/max/two-interior fraction × sign × RC × TOP × prior
DE/PE/C1 matrix, legal sticky IE/SF pairings, full canaries, repeat FRNDINT,
FNSTSW/FNCLEX and atomic malformed/pseudo-denormal/tag/control/status rejects.
Add one literal seeded `D9 FC DF E0` fixture with explicit project-fixture
provenance. Keep JIT/native admission closed; physical x86 and Mac mini checks
remain for the combined final S2-31 acceptance substage and must not be run as
part of this implementation substage.

pseudo-infinity/NaN, malformed encodings or wrong tags. Unnormal inputs were

#### S2-30bp. Bare FLD ST(i), i=0..6 (bounded raw-copy push slice)

Generalize S2-30bo without duplicating its execution gate: admit only exact unprefixed Long64 `D9 C0..C6`. Source is physical `(old_TOP+i)&7`; destination remains `(old_TOP+7)&7`. Require present x87 state, FCW exactly `0x037f`, `FSW & 0x80ff == 0`, a source tagged Valid with canonical-Normal binary80 or Zero with exact signed binary80 zero, and an Empty destination. Preflight both before mutation. Capture and copy the source's exact ten bytes and tag; retain the old source and destination bytes under Empty remain opaque. Set TOP to destination, clear C1, preserve C0/C2/C3 under the established deterministic local policy, record FIP from old RIP, advance two and retire once. Keep C7, prefixes, other x87 classes, ES/B/status gates, stack exceptions and native/JIT execution denied.

Verify 35,840 full-state successes (seven indices × five magnitudes × two signs × eight TOPs × sixteen prior CC patterns × four snapshots), with source selection before TOP changes, wrap, source retention, and indices above zero independent of old ST(0). Preserve source/destination/tag/environment rejection and boundary atomicity. Schema admits only `D9 C0..C6`, each optionally followed by `FNSTSW AX`, plus the existing `FLD1`/`FLDZ` producer streams with one admitted indexed load and `FNSTSW AX`. Add one literal success fixture per new index and signed-zero/wrap, nonadjacent-source-with-Empty-ST(0), wrong-source-tag and occupied-destination cases. JIT/native and physical x86 checks remain deferred to the final shared physical substage; ISSUE-019 remains open.


#### S2-30bq. Bare FFREE ST(0) (bounded tag-only free slice)

Admit exactly bare unprefixed Long64 `DD C0`; `DD C1..C7`, prefixes, memory forms, WAIT/FWAIT and aliases stay unsupported. Require present x87 state, FCW `0x037f`, and `FSW & 0x80ff == 0`. Prior tag and all ten payload bytes at physical old TOP are opaque, including already Empty, SNaN and malformed values. Success changes only that physical tag to Empty; preserve TOP, all raw payloads, other tags, all C0..C3 (including C1 under the local undefined-field policy), GPR/RFLAGS/memory, FCW/FSW, FDP/FOP; set FIP to old RIP, advance RIP by two and retire once. The operation is idempotent and produces no exception or pending state.

Verify 3,072 full-state successes (eight TOPs × sixteen prior CC patterns × four old tags × six opaque payload canaries), full snapshot and memory preservation, nine forbidden FSW bits individually/together, bad FCW/missing state, decoder neighbors/prefix/truncation and STOP/budget/fault no-commit. Composition must show `FFREE ST(0) → FINCSTP → FLD1` reuses the freed physical cell while preserving its raw bytes until FLD1 commits. Schema streams are exactly `ddc0`, `ddc0dfe0`, `ddc0d9c0dfe0`, and `ddc0d9f7d9e8dfe0`; add literal fixtures for TOP=7/C1=1 mixed canaries, already Empty, opaque SNaN/malformed, composition, and environment rejection. Keep JIT/native/physical acceptance denied/deferred and ISSUE-019 open.

#### S2-30br. Generalize bounded FFREE to all `ST(i)` indices

Generalize the tag-only operation to exact unprefixed Long64 `DD C0..C7` and

require present x87 state, FCW `0x037f`, and `FSW & 0x80ff == 0`. The selected

two-bit tag to Empty, preserving TOP, every payload and other tag, full FCW/FSW
including C0..C3, FDP/FOP and all non-x87 state; record FIP=old RIP, advance
RIP by two and retire once. Repeated FFREE is idempotent. Do not classify or

Cover the full 24,576-state matrix (eight indices × eight TOPs × sixteen prior
CC combinations × four tags × six opaque payloads), retaining the earlier
3,072 `ST(0)` cases. Include wrap for index/TOP, one-tag-only mutation and
repeated operations. Reject each forbidden FSW bit individually and together,
bad FCW and missing state atomically; retain decoder, fetch, prefix, memory,
WAIT/FFREEP, budget and stop-boundary denials. Schema admits exactly nineteen
streams: each bare `DD C0..C7` at budget one and each followed by `DF E0` at
budget two, plus `DD C0 D9 C0 DF E0` (FFREE commits then FLD rejects),
`DD C0 D9 F7 D9 E8 DF E0`, and `DD C7 D9 E8 DF E0`. Add seven indexed literal

and `ST(7)→FLD1` physical reuse, plus indexed environment rejection. The CLI
checks snapshots and JIT denial. Keep ISSUE-019 open; no Mini, SSH, native or
physical x86 tests are included.

#### S2-30bs. Bare FNOP with a bounded environment gate

Admit only unprefixed Long64 `D9 D0`, requiring present x87 state, FCW exactly

memory, JIT or native behavior.

Cover 4,608 full snapshots (eight TOPs × sixteen CC patterns × six tag patterns
× six raw layouts), all nine forbidden FSW bits individually and together,
invalid FCW variants, missing x87 state, decode/prefix/WAIT neighbors, fetch,
truncation, STOP and budget atomicity, repeated FNOP and FFREE→FNOP→FLD1

`ddc7d9d0d9e8dfe0`; bad-environment fixtures use only bare `d9d0` at budget

#### S2-30bt. Bounded bare FXAM (Normal and signed-zero classification)

Admit only exact unprefixed Long64 `D9 E5` with present x87 state, FCW `0x037f`, and `FSW & 0x80ff == 0`. Physical old TOP may be Valid-tagged canonical Normal or Zero-tagged exact signed binary80 zero. Normal maps to `C3:C2:C0 = 010` (`FSW` mask `0x0400`), zero maps to `100` (`0x4000`), and C1 is replaced with the source sign. Replace all C0/C1/C2/C3 using `(old_FSW & !0x4700) | result`; preserve TOP and every other x87 byte/field and machine state. Set FIP to old RIP, advance RIP by two and retire once. Reject other tags/classes, malformed payloads, invalid FCW/status, missing state, prefixes, neighbors, truncation/fetch and execution boundaries atomically. Keep FTST's admission gate unchanged; do not model Empty/Special FXAM outputs, exceptions, native execution or JIT.

Verify 5,120 full-state successes (four canonical Normal representatives: minimum normal, 1, 1+ULP and maximum finite; plus exact Zero; both signs, eight TOP values, sixteen old CC combinations, four non-source canary layouts) and 10,752 rejected class/tag combinations (42 × two signs × eight TOPs × sixteen old CC patterns), plus environment and boundary rejects. Schema allows exactly `d9e5`, `d9e5dfe0`, `d9e5d9e5dfe0`, `d9e8d9e5dfe0`, `d9eed9e5dfe0`, `d9e8d9e0d9e5dfe0`, and `d9eed9e0d9e5dfe0`. Literal fixtures cover signed Normal/TOP wrap, FNSTSW, repeat, FLD1/FLDZ producer composition with and without FCHS, wrong tag, Empty, Special, ES|B and invalid FCW. JIT/native remain denied. ISSUE-019 stays open; do not run Mac mini, SSH or physical x86 checks.

Implement only `DA C1` in exact unprefixed Long64 form. Preflight Valid+canonical

and budgets recorded in the CPU contract. Literal CLI fixtures cover both CF

S2-30bv for source indices `i=0..7`.

available, CR0.EM=CR0.TS=0, and no pending exception; availability faults,

#### S2-30cl. Bare register-only `FPREM ST(0), ST(1)` (`D9 F8`)

Admit only exact unprefixed Long64 `D9 F8`. Require present x87 state, absent

twelve all-exception-masked PC24/53/64 encodings, and `FSW & 0x80df == 0`.

PE. Preserve ST(1), TOP, other cells/tags, FCW, FDP, FOP and all unrelated
state; write FIP=old RIP, advance RIP by two and retire once. No data memory is
accessed. RC and PC do not alter this exact arithmetic. General x87 exception
delivery, x87 availability/CR0 gates, #NM/#MF, JIT/native execution, schema/CLI
fixtures and physical acceptance are outside scope; ISSUE-019 remains open.

itself accepts gap 64 by contract; tests ensure the ISA gate refuses it first.

#### S2-30cm. Bare register-only `FPREM1 ST(0), ST(1)` (`D9 F5`)

Admit only exact unprefixed Long64 `D9 F5`. Require an x87 snapshot with absent
FCS/FDS selectors, one of the twelve all-exception-masked PC24/53/64 FCWs,

binary80 at physical TOP and TOP+1. Require divisor exponent `e1 >= -16318`
and `D=e0-e1 < 64` before the helper. The cutoff is stricter than FPREM's:
at D=-1 the nearest-even remainder can be a signed coefficient of one on the

exception bits including PE, ST(1), TOP, other tags/payloads, FCW/FDP/FOP and
unrelated state; set FIP to old RIP, advance RIP by two and retire once. No
data-memory access occurs. FCW PC/RC, general x87 exception delivery,
availability/CR0 gates, schema/CLI, native/JIT and physical acceptance remain
outside scope. FPREM, S2-30, and ISSUE-019 remain open.

#### S2-30da. Bare `FMULP ST(i), ST(0)` with bounded FCW precision

Extend only exact bare Long64 `DE C8..CF`. Reuse the S2-30cu precision
multiplication contract and helper with old logical destination `ST(i)` and
source `ST(0)`. Require present x87 state, absent FCS/FDS, one of twelve
all-exception-masked PC24/53/64 FCWs, and `FSW & 0x80df == 0`. Both used
physical operands must be Valid-tagged canonical nonzero Normal binary80
values of either sign. For `i=0`, validate one Valid TOP register and square
that value. Accept only finite Normal results; unsupported environment,
operand, result range, or execution-boundary cases refuse before mutation.

marking old physical TOP Empty, including the `i=0` alias case. Set PE to old
PE OR `inexact`, replace C1 with the helper's pre-carry magnitude
`incremented` diagnostic, and preserve C0/C2/C3 under the deterministic local
policy. Advance TOP, preserve all payloads (including the popped TOP), tags
other than the popped tag, FCW/FDP/FOP and unrelated state; set FIP to old RIP,
advance RIP by two, retire once and make no data-memory access. Retain the
existing decoder/schema admission for the eight DE encodings and keep native
x87, JIT and general exception delivery closed.

by flipping only the sign bit in a local copy of validated ST(0), then adding
to ST(i); do not negate a rounded FSUB result. For `i=0`, cancellation to zero
remains atomically Unsupported. Accept only finite Normal exact or rounded
results.

On success, write the old physical TOP, accumulate PE from `inexact`, replace
C1 from the helper's pre-carry `incremented`, preserve C0/C2/C3 by local policy,
preserve tags, source bytes and unrelated state, record FIP=old RIP, advance
RIP by two and retire once. Refusals, fetch faults, STOP and zero budget remain
atomic; register execution performs no data access. `DC` reverse, `DE` pop,
and JIT/native execution remain unchanged; bounded `D8 E0..E7` FSUB is S2-30cq.
Coverage includes all
TOP/index pairs, four sign combinations, all twelve FCWs, midpoint neighbors,
directed modes, gaps 1/63/64 and 65+, alias/cancellation, subnormal/overflow,
malformed inputs and execution boundaries. See the [CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#local-s2-30cr-bounded-fsubr-st0-sti-d8-e8-ef),
[shared report](../reports/STAGE_2_REPORT.md#s2-30cr--bounded-fsubr-st0-sti), and
[standalone report](../reports/S2_30CR_X87_FSUBR_PRECISION.md). Intel SDM Rev.
093 Vol. 2A `FSUBR/FSUBRP/FISUBR` pp. 3-397–3-399; Vol. 1 §8.1.5.2/Table 8-2,
§8.1.5.3 and §8.5.6 p. 8-30. S2-30 and ISSUE-019 remain open.

#### S2-18j — bare CLD/STD (локальный профиль)

Только Long64 primary-map bare FC/FD, длина 1, без префиксов, ModR/M и
immediate. CLD очищает только DF, STD устанавливает только DF; каждый
успешный шаг увеличивает RIP на один и retire на один. Не обращается к
данным, GPR, segment/x87 или guest pointers. `FlagEffects` определяет только
DF и сохраняет остальные definedness bits. Все одиночные префиксы отвергаются
как вне профиля; это admission boundary, не утверждение о #UD или precedence.
`D9 FC` остаётся FRNDINT. Native/JIT/physical acceptance не входят; S2-18
остаётся открытой.

#### S2-18l — non-REP STOS с address-size 32

Добавить только Long64 non-REP `67 AA`, `67 66 AB`, `67 AB`, `67 48 AB`.
Стартовый адрес — zero-extend(EDI), запись выполняется одной непрерывной
width-sized операцией без побайтного wrap на 4 GiB; после успеха RDI получает
zero-extended `(EDI ± width) mod 2^32` согласно DF. RAX целиком сохраняется,
как и остальные GPR/flags/definedness/segment/x87. Ошибки записи атомарны в
локальной модели: полный CPU/RAM pre-state сохраняется, retirement равен 0;
архитектурный fault остаётся гостевым, backend error остаётся HarnessError.
Это bounded local policy под ISSUE-016, не hardware restart claim.

Покрытие: полная матрица core состояний, границы, store failures, prefix
admission и ровно 43 literal schema-v2 fixtures с полными expected snapshots;
runner проверяет snapshots/RAM, retirements и закрытый JIT, Linux-only native
test отвергает четыре формы до tracee. Mac mini/native физическая проверка
остаётся объединённой в общем финальном substage. ISSUE-016/020/021 остаются
открытыми; S2-18 и Stage 2 в целом остаются открытыми.

#### S2-18m — non-REP SCAS с address-size 32

Добавить только Long64 non-REP `67 AE`, `67 66 AF`, `67 AF`, `67 48 AF`.
Чтение выполняется одним непрерывным width-sized доступом из zero-extend(EDI);
побайтного wrap на 4 GiB нет. После успешного сравнения с аккумулятором
обновить шесть арифметических flags/definedness по CMP, затем zero-extend RDI
после `(EDI ± width) mod 2^32` по DF. RAX и прочие регистры сохраняются.
Произвольные входные arithmetic flags/definedness для non-REP SCAS допустимы;
REPE entry gate сюда не переносится. Ошибка чтения сохраняет полный state,
flags-definedness и RAM; backend errors остаются HarnessError. Это один
read-only профиль и он не закрывает ISSUE-016/020/021.

Покрытие: 18,432 полных success states, 512 definedness вариантов, 96
address-boundary cases, 96 ошибок чтения, 73 prefix rejects и 39 literal
schema-v2 fixtures. Проверить TEST→SCAS success/fault, CLD/STD, бюджет/fetch,
normalization, RCX=0 и прежние SCAS/REPE regressions. JIT остаётся закрытым;
Linux-only native admission отклоняет четыре формы до tracee. Mac mini/native
физическая проверка остаётся единой в общем финальном substage; S2-18 и Stage
2 остаются открытыми до acceptance.

#### S2-18n — non-REP CMPS с address-size 32

Добавить только Long64 non-REP `67 A6`, `67 66 A7`, `67 A7` и `67 48 A7`.
Начальные адреса — zero-extend(ESI) и zero-extend(EDI); выполнить два
непрерывных width-sized чтения в порядке flat DS:[ESI], затем flat ES:[EDI].
Отдельные байты операнда не оборачиваются на границе 4 GiB. После двух
успешных чтений вычислить `memory[ESI] - memory[EDI]`, зафиксировать CMP flags
и zero-extended `(ESI/EDI +/- width) mod 2^32` по DF. Ошибка любого чтения не
коммитит CPU state; ошибка второго сохраняет первое чтение в локальном trace.
Missing mapping и backend errors остаются HarnessError. ESI-first — только
локальная политика; dual-invalid hardware priority и MMIO rollback не
утверждаются (ISSUE-020).

Покрытие: 63 literal schema-v2 fixtures: 8 success, 8 unmapped, 4 budget-zero,
16 pointer wraps, 6 непрерывных чтений через 4 GiB, 2 prefix normalizations,
3 `TEST+CMPSB`, 8 `CLD/STD`, 4 alias и 4 dual-unmapped cases. Независимо
зафиксировать полный GPR/RFLAGS/definedness/RIP/memory/retirement snapshot и
адрес первой ошибки. Проверить fixture generation/freshness и runner snapshots;
не использовать interpreter как oracle. Core regression matrices дополнительно
проверяют 55,296 success states, 512 flag-definedness states, 576 read failures,
192 boundaries, 72 aliases, 36 overlaps, 128 dual-invalid error combinations
(четыре пары ошибок × четыре ширины × два значения DF × две старшие части RSI ×
две старшие части RDI), and retries that reread changed source RAM after a second-read
failure. JIT/native admission остаётся закрытой.
Physical/Mac mini acceptance не выполняется здесь; ISSUE-016/020/021 и S2-18
остаются открытыми.

#### S2-18o — non-REP MOVS с address-size 32

Добавить только bounded Long64 non-REP `67 A4`, `67 66 A5`, `67 A5` и
`67 48 A5` MOVSB/W/D/Q, с принятыми нормализациями `48 67 A5` (dword),
`67 48 66 A5` (word) и `67 66 48 A5` (qword). Начальные адреса независимо
zero-extend ESI/EDI. Выполнить source read, затем ровно одну width-sized
destination write; диапазоны остаются непрерывными через 4 GiB, а overlap
использует исходные source bytes. Только после успешной записи обновить оба
индекса по DF modulo 2^32. Сохранить RAX, RCX, flags/definedness и unrelated
state; RCX=0 не подавляет non-REP MOVS.

Source fault запрещает destination access. Destination fault сохраняет source
read в trace, но не коммитит CPU/RAM/retirement согласно локальной
all-or-error модели; это не hardware restart, MMIO rollback или SMP atomicity
утверждение (ISSUE-016). Источник имеет локальный приоритет при dual-invalid
(ISSUE-021), без hardware exception-priority утверждения.

Покрытие: 73 literal schema-v2 fixtures; core matrices — 55,296 success,
512 definedness, 192 pointer boundaries, 576 failures, 72 aliases, 36 overlaps
и 32 dual-invalid. End-to-end `Unsupported` проверяет 73 непокрытых prefix
варианта, включая REP и сегментные/repeated-address формы. Также проверить
fetch truncation, budget 0, STOP/stop_rip, TEST/CLD/STD compositions, readonly
source/write-only destination, destination partial-fault no-prefix-mutation,
retry after source mutation, MOVS64/REP regressions. Native admission остаётся
addr64-only, JIT closed. Перегенерацию и runner snapshots проверить локально;
физические/Mac mini прогоны выполнять только в общем финальном substage.


#### S2-19s — bounded REPNE SCASW/D/Q с address-size 32

Добавить только Long64 `AF` с normalized group1 F2, address override 67 и
шириной W/D/Q: `F2 67 66 AF` — W, `F2 67 AF` и `67 F2 AF` — D,
`F2 67 48 AF` — Q. Сохранять legacy REX reset: `F2 67 48 66 AF` — W,
`F2 67 66 48 AF` — Q, `F2 48 67 AF` — D. Допускается каждый effective
REX.W `48..4F`. Addr32 F2 AE и существующий F3 профиль остаются неизменны;
F2 A7, addr64 F2, byte F2 для AF, LOCK, segment, duplicate prefix groups
и effective non-W REX остаются unsupported. Старые `run`,
`run_with_rflags_defined` и single-step entry points остаются fail-closed.

До ECX/data read требовать definedness всех arithmetic flags, не ограничивая
их concrete values. ECX=0 не читает и сохраняет полные RCX/RDI/RAX/flags/mask,
затем продвигает RIP и retires once. Иначе выполнить один contiguous width
read из zero-extended EDI; после success сравнить accumulator width minus data,
зафиксировать CMP flags, modulo-32 EDI ± width и zero-extended ECX-1.
Операнд не делится на два чтения на границе 4 GiB. REPNE завершается при
ECX=0 или ZF=1 до STOP, затем применяется лимит 1024 успешных сравнений.
Архитектурный fetch/data fault восстанавливает entry RFLAGS/mask, оставляет
счётчик/индекс после предыдущих успешных сравнений и очищает token; backend
ошибка оставляет checkpoint/token для retry.

Оpaque `RepContinuation` расширить kind, operand size, address size и
instruction length плюс существующие semantic checkpoint/context/original flags.
Проверять полное состояние до callback; после decode сверять kind/width/address/
length до data read. Equivalent prefix order той же длины допустим; другая
длина и cross-kind/width/address tokens отклоняются. Token остаётся caller-side
only и не сериализуется schema v2.

Покрытие этого среза включает exact prefix matrix, независимую W/D/Q CMP
модель по DF/начальному ZF/равенству/count, high halves, zero count, zero-extended
starting EDI, 4-GiB contiguous Qword/tail behavior, fault after progress, retry
checkpoint, STOP/limit resume and changed-length rejection. Literal fixtures
содержат serialization-only W/D/Q complete snapshots. ISSUE-020 остаётся
CMPS-only открытой политикой; этот SCAS профиль не расширяет её. Native/JIT,
physical x86, Mac mini и SSH проверки не выполнять.

#### S2-19t — bounded REPNE CMPSW/D/Q с address-size 32

Добавить только Long64 `A7` с normalized F2, address override 67 и widths
W/D/Q по той же exact prefix allowlist, что addr32 REPNE SCASW/D/Q:
`F2 67 66 A7` / `67 F2 66 A7` — W; `F2 67 A7` / `67 F2 A7` — D;
`F2 67 REX.W A7` / `67 F2 REX.W A7` — Q для REX `48..4F`. Сохранить
REX reset: `F2 REX 67 A7` — D, `F2 67 REX 66 A7` — W и
`F2 67 66 REX A7` — Q. Другие префиксы, repeat/segment/LOCK,
effective non-W REX, addr64 F2 и прочие CMPS формы остаются закрыты;
byte/F3 профили неизменны. Добавить `Operation::RepneCmpsWdqAddr32{size}`;
старые APIs остаются fail-closed, explicit continuation API — единственная
точка исполнения.

Continuation token сохраняет CMPS kind и width, address size, instruction
length, RSI и общее REP checkpoint state. До доступа проверять kind/width/
address/length; equivalent same-length prefix reorder допустим. Чтения за один
шаг: width bytes из zero-extended ESI, затем width bytes из EDI; arithmetic —
source−destination. Оба индекса обновляются modulo 32 на ±width по DF, без
wrap внутри операнда. До обоих успешных чтений не менять flags/index/count.
Архитектурный fault восстанавливает entry flags/definedness, оставляя прошлый
прогресс; backend error сохраняет checkpoint/token, retry повторяет оба
чтения. Source-first и dual-invalid остаются local ISSUE-020 policy, без
hardware-priority/MMIO rollback утверждения. Завершение ZF=1 или ECX=0
предшествует STOP и лимиту 1024 успешных сравнений.

Coverage includes exact prefix tests, independent W/D/Q CMP modeling, token
identity and reordered-prefix resume, architectural source/destination faults
after progress, changed-operand backend retry, source-first dual-invalid trace,
overlap, contiguous 4-GiB accesses and width-exact tail failures, three literal
schema-v2 fixtures with a serialization-only generator, testkit STOP/1024/
multiple-resume sidecar, and CLI/JIT denial. `cargo test --workspace
--all-targets --offline`, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`,
`cargo fmt --all -- --check`, all 131 CPU Python tests, generator freshness,
targeted runner snapshot/JIT denial, `git diff --check`, and Graphify update
passed. Independent `gpt-6.1-sol` medium code review found no actionable
defects in decoder admission, continuation identity, index/count wrap, operand
ordering, fault/retry handling, fixtures or documentation. ISSUE-020 remains open. See [CPU
contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#local-s2-19t-bounded-repne-cmpswdq-address-size-32-contract), [interpreter notes](../testing/INTERPRETER.md#repne-cmpswdq-address-size-32--s2-19t), [fixture README](../../tests/fixtures/x86/stage2/README.md#bounded-repne-cmpswdq-address-size-32-fixtures-s2-19t), and [report](../reports/STAGE_2_REPORT.md#s2-19t--bounded-repne-cmpswdq-addr32).

#### S2-34.8a — local legacy MOVSS register-to-register

Добавлен exact local profile `s2-long-movss-reg-v1`. Допускается только
legacy `F3 0F 10 /r`, ModR/M.mod=3, при одном эффективном mandatory `F3` и
необязательном одном REX с R/B, расположенном после F3 и перед `0F`; индексы
XMM ограничены 0–15. `DEST[31:0]` получает raw `SRC[31:0]`, прежние
`DEST[127:32]` сохраняются. Это подтверждено Intel SDM revision 093, Vol. 2B,
MOVSS: register-source форма сохраняет биты 127:32, тогда как отдельная
memory-load форма очищает их. Использованы официальные [SDM revision 093
PDF](https://cdrdv2-public.intel.com/929354/253667-093-sdm-vol-2b.pdf) и
[страница Intel SDM](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/articles/technical/intel-sdm.html).
F3 здесь обязательный opcode-prefix и не задаёт REP; регистровая форма не
читает/пишет память. VEX/EVEX, memory, F2/66, 0F 11, другие перестановки
префиксов, feature gates, #UD/#NM delivery и native/JIT остаются вне профиля.

Проверки покрывают 16×16 XMM, literal high-register fixture, alias/self,
сохранение остальных XMM/x87/MXCSR/GPR/RFLAGS при RCX и DF, отсутствие data
callbacks, prefix/memory rejection, truncation, 4/5-byte длины, STOP/budget и
отсутствующее SSE/x87 state. S2-34 и D/System остаются открытыми.

#### S2-34.8b — local legacy reverse-direction MOVSS register-to-register

Добавлен отдельный exact local fixture profile `s2-long-movss-store-reg-v1`:
только legacy `F3 0F 11 /r`, ModR/M.mod=3, с обязательным F3 и максимум одним
effective REX.R/B после F3 непосредственно перед `0F`; REX.W/X запрещены.
Для этой opcode direction `ModR/M.reg` — source, а `ModR/M.r/m` — destination.
Исполняется только raw copy `DEST[31:0] = SRC[31:0]`, остальные 96 бит
destination сохраняются. XMM индексы ограничены 0–15. Отдельный versioned
profile сохраняет точный контракт ранее существовавшего `0F 10` profile.

Основание: Intel SDM revision 093, Vol. 2B, MOVSS entry `F3 0F 11 /r`,
Op/En C (`xmm2/m32, xmm1`): для register operand ModR/M.r/m задаёт xmm2
destination, а ModR/M.reg — xmm1 source; legacy register result сохраняет
destination bits 127:32. Используются [официальный SDM revision 093 Volume 2B
PDF](https://cdrdv2-public.intel.com/929354/253667-093-sdm-vol-2b.pdf) и
[страница Intel SDM](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/articles/technical/intel-sdm.html).
F3 для MOVSS — обязательный opcode prefix, не REP: эта форма не потребляет
RCX, не меняет направление по DF и не делает data-memory callbacks.

Тесты включают все 16×16 operand mappings, high XMM registers, alias/self,
асимметричный источник/назначение, полное сохранение x87/SSE/MXCSR/GPR/RFLAGS,
отсутствие memory callbacks, strict fixture admission (включая отказ `0F 10`
и memory forms), prefix/VEX/EVEX rejection, truncation, missing state,
STOP/budget и literal XMM8→XMM9 fixture. Native/JIT, feature gates,
`#UD`/`#NM` delivery и physical CPU execution не проверяются; S2-34 и
D/System остаются открытыми.

#### S2-34.8c — local legacy MOVSS m32 load from `[RAX]`

Добавлен отдельный точный profile `s2-long-movss-mem-load-v1` для legacy
`F3 0F 10 /r` с ModR/M.mod=00 и r/m=000 (`[RAX]`); разрешён optional REX.R
для выбора XMM8–XMM15, но REX.B/X/W и SIB/displacement отклоняются. При
успехе один 4-byte `GuestMemory::read` загружает low dword XMM и обнуляет
bits 127:32; прочее состояние сохраняется, RIP фиксируется после успешного
чтения. Ошибка backend сохраняет CPU state. Fault priority и hardware guest
exception delivery этим срезом не подтверждаются.

Intel SDM revision 093, Vol. 2B, Order Number 253667-093US (September 2026),
MOVSS table/operation: `F3 0F 10 /r`, Op/En A, source m32; legacy memory-load
pseudocode clears `DEST[127:32]` (pp. 4-117–4-119). See [official PDF]
(https://cdrdv2-public.intel.com/929354/253667-093-sdm-vol-2b.pdf). The profile assumes SSE and
CR0/CR4 prerequisites; it does not implement CPUID/CPU gates or #UD/#NM
delivery. Native/JIT and physical execution remain excluded. Tests cover the
exact profile, all sixteen XMM destinations, malformed code, 4-byte range
boundaries, injected read failure, no-commit/no-extra access, truncation,
STOP/budget and the literal runner fixture.

#### S2-34.8d — local legacy MOVSS m32 store to `[RAX]`

Added exact local profile `s2-long-movss-mem-store-v1` for legacy
`F3 0F 11 /r`, ModR/M.mod=00/rm=000 (`[RAX]`). One optional REX.R directly
after F3 selects source XMM8–XMM15 through ModR/M.reg. REX.B/X/W, SIB,
displacement, other bases, register destination, other prefixes, and VEX/EVEX
are rejected. The shared `MemoryOperand` validates a four-byte range; execution
performs exactly one `GuestMemory::write` of the source low dword and advances
RIP only after success. No XMM or unrelated state changes; backend write
failure leaves CPU state unchanged.

Intel SDM revision 093, Vol. 2B, Order Number 253667-093US (September 2026),
MOVSS `F3 0F 11 /r`, Op/En C, specifies `xmm2/m32, xmm1`: ModR/M.r/m is the
destination and ModR/M.reg is the source; the memory-store operation copies
`SRC[31:0]` to `DEST[31:0]` (pp. 4-117–4-119). Sources: [official Intel PDF]
(https://cdrdv2-public.intel.com/929354/253667-093-sdm-vol-2b.pdf) and [Intel SDM page]
(https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/articles/technical/intel-sdm.html).
Tests cover all source XMM indices, exact write/no-read callback counts,
canaries, range boundaries, injected write failure, truncated fetch, STOP and
budget, missing SSE state, malformed encodings, a handwritten literal fixture,
and native/JIT denial. This local diagnostic profile assumes SSE and CR0/CR4
prerequisites; fault priority, guest exception delivery, alignment guarantees,
feature gates, native/JIT execution, and physical verification are not claimed.

#### S2-34.9a — local legacy scalar-double MOVSD register-to-register

Добавлен отдельный exact profile `s2-long-movsd-reg-v1`: только legacy
`F2 0F 10 /r`, ModR/M.mod=3, обязательный F2 и максимум один REX.R/B после
F2 перед `0F`; REX.W/X запрещены, XMM индексы 0–15. ModR/M.reg выбирает
destination, ModR/M.r/m — source. Выполняется raw copy `DEST[63:0] =
SRC[63:0]`; прежние `DEST[127:64]` и всё прочее состояние сохраняются.
Используется отдельная exact schema, поскольку существующие MOVSS/MOVUPS
profiles имеют другую ширину и prefix contract.

Основание: Intel SDM revision 093, Vol. 2B, Order Number 253667-093US
(September 2026), MOVSD `F2 0F 10 /r`, Op/En A, назначает ModR/M.reg как
destination и ModR/M.r/m как source; legacy operation копирует low qword и
оставляет `DEST[MAXVL:64]` неизменным (pp. 4-108–4-110). Использованы
[официальный PDF](https://cdrdv2-public.intel.com/929354/253667-093-sdm-vol-2b.pdf) и
[страница Intel SDM](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/articles/technical/intel-sdm.html).
F2 здесь обязательный opcode prefix, не REPNE; opcode A5 для string MOVSD
является отдельной primary-map инструкцией и отвергается этим профилем.

Покрытие включает 16×16 mappings, REX.R/B combinations, alias/self, zeros,
ones, alternating и NaN-like raw patterns, sentinels старших битов destination,
сохранение XMM/x87/MXCSR/GPR/RFLAGS при RCX=0 и DF=1, отсутствие data-memory
callbacks, missing state, truncation, STOP/budget, strict prefix/memory/
string/VEX/EVEX rejection и literal XMM8←XMM9 fixture. Native/JIT, CPUID,
`#UD`/`#NM`, physical x86 и широкая готовность SSE2 не заявляются. Плановый
срез предполагает явно заданное SSE2 state и architectural preconditions.

#### S2-34.9b — local legacy reverse-direction scalar-double MOVSD register

Добавлен отдельный exact profile `s2-long-movsd-store-reg-v1`: только legacy
`F2 0F 11 /r` с ModR/M.mod=3, optional one REX.R/B непосредственно после F2
перед `0F`; REX.W/X и остальные префиксы запрещены. ModR/M.reg — source,
ModR/M.r/m — destination, оба XMM0–XMM15. Копируются исходные биты
`SRC[63:0]` в `DEST[63:0]`; `DEST[127:64]` и прочее CPU state сохраняются.
F2 здесь mandatory opcode prefix, не REPNE; RCX/DF не участвуют, data-memory
callback отсутствует. Строковый `A5` остаётся отдельной инструкцией.

Intel SDM revision 093 Vol. 2B, entry MOVSD, `F2 0F 11 /r`, Op/En C,
описывает `MOVSD xmm2/m64, xmm1`: ModR/M.r/m — destination, ModR/M.reg —
source; для XMM destination обновляются только младшие 64 бита (pp. 4-108–
4-110). Source: [official Intel PDF](https://cdrdv2-public.intel.com/929354/253667-093-sdm-vol-2b.pdf)
и [страница SDM](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/articles/technical/intel-sdm.html).
Литеральный XMM9←XMM8 fixture проверяет асимметричные старшие sentinel bits.
Полная matrix 16×16, prefix/neighbor rejection, missing state, truncation,
STOP/budget и отсутствие data callbacks покрыты локально; native/JIT и
физическое исполнение не заявляются. S2-34/D/System остаются открытыми.

#### S2-34.9c — local legacy scalar-double MOVSD m64 load from `[RAX]`

Добавлен отдельный exact profile `s2-long-movsd-mem-load-v1`. Он принимает
только legacy `F2 0F 10 /r` с ModR/M.mod=00, r/m=000 (`[RAX]`), обязательным F2
и максимум одним REX непосредственно после F2. У REX допускается только
REX.R; REX.W/X/B, SIB, displacement, другие базы, segment/address/operand
prefixes, LOCK, duplicate prefix/REX, reverse `0F 11`, VEX/EVEX и string MOVSD
`A5` отвергаются. ModR/M.reg с REX.R выбирает XMM0–XMM15. Этот профиль не
расширяет отдельные register-only контракты S2-34.9a/.9b.

Основание: Intel SDM revision 093, Vol. 2B, Order Number 253667-093US,
MOVSD `F2 0F 10 /r`, Op/En A: ModR/M.reg задаёт XMM destination, ModR/M.r/m —
m64 source. Legacy memory-load operation копирует `SRC[63:0]` в
`DEST[63:0]`, обнуляет `DEST[127:64]`, а биты `DEST[MAXVL:128]` оставляет без
изменения (pp. 4-108–4-110). См. [официальный Intel PDF]
(https://cdrdv2-public.intel.com/929354/253667-093-sdm-vol-2b.pdf) и
[страницу Intel SDM](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/articles/technical/intel-sdm.html).
F2 является mandatory opcode prefix, а не REPNE; primary-map string MOVSD
`A5` остаётся отдельной инструкцией.

Для `[RAX..RAX+7]` executor сначала валидирует весь canonical48 byte range,
затем выполняет ровно один `GuestMemory::read` в 8-byte временный буфер. После
успешного чтения он копирует low qword, очищает destination high qword и
обновляет RIP; x87, MXCSR, GPR, RFLAGS и прочие XMM не меняются. Диапазонные,
backend и injected fetch/read ошибки не фиксируют XMM/RIP; это local rollback,
а не утверждение об аппаратном fault-priority или guest #PF delivery.
Handwritten literal fixture содержит XMM8 load, data canaries и полные
before/after snapshots. Decoder/schema/executor проверки охватывают все 16
назначений, REX.R, partial-lane patterns, canonical границы, один 8-byte read,
отсутствие writes, rollback, STOP/budget, missing SSE, усечение/fetch failure,
strict negative encoding matrix и native/JIT denial. Control-register gates,
alignment/fault-order claims, CPUID, native/JIT execution и physical x86 не
входят в срез; предполагаются явно заданные SSE2 state и architectural
preconditions. S2-34/D/System остаётся открытым.

#### S2-34.9d — local legacy scalar-double MOVSD m64 store to `[RAX]`

Add separate profile `s2-long-movsd-mem-store-v1`. Admit only `F2 0F 11 /r`
with ModR/M.mod=00 and r/m=000 (`[RAX]`), mandatory F2 and at most one
immediately following REX with only REX.R permitted. ModR/M.reg plus REX.R
selects source XMM0–XMM15. Keep this distinct from reverse register `0F 11`
and string `A5`; reject other address modes, prefixes, REX bits, VEX and EVEX.

Intel SDM revision 093, Vol. 2B, MOVSD `F2 0F 11 /r`, Op/En C, defines
ModR/M.r/m as the memory destination and ModR/M.reg as the XMM source. Write
exactly source bits 63:0 through one shared `MemoryOperand` write. Do not alter
the source or any other CPU state. Validate the full canonical48 eight-byte
range before the callback and commit RIP only after the write succeeds. Add a
high-register literal fixture, canaries, all 16 source indices, boundaries,
fault/no-commit, fetch/STOP/budget and negative-form coverage, and explicit
native/JIT denial. This remains local interpreter evidence only; hardware
fault ordering/delivery, CPUID, native, and physical execution are excluded.

**Start of a bounded diagnostic slice:** name one exact opcode/prefix/mode/
operand form, keep it in a versioned local profile, state SSE/SSE2 and CR0/CR4
assumptions, define affected state and local failure/no-commit behavior, and
provide local semantic plus literal fixture coverage. This does not require
settling generic CPUID/MSR/boot policy or make native, JIT or physical claims.

**Full parent S2-34 completion:** keep the parent open until the selected
profile's instruction/state scope is explicit, its required forms have
architectural state, gate, fault and alignment requirements accounted for,
and required register and memory cases pass an SSE-capable native oracle. Local
interpreter results are not native/JIT or physical evidence. The current
physical harness admits integer profiles only; physical SSE evidence is
`not_run`. Existing Mac mini/SSH batch validation remains at the end-of-stage
acceptance batch; this inventory does not move or execute that batch. Do not
infer that arbitrary additional opcodes are required before the profile and
oracle decision is made.

with ModR/M.mod=3. Mandatory 66 distinguishes XMM/SSE2 from unprefixed MMX
PXOR; only one optional effective REX with R/B is admitted. Implement raw
128-bit XOR and deny memory, unsupported prefixes/REX bits, VEX/EVEX and
native/JIT. This child slice does not close parent S2-35, parent S2-34, or the
Stage 2 dependency `S2-35 → S2-34`; those remain open.

#### S2-35.33 — local-only bounded register `PACKUSWB`

The bounded profile `s2-long-packuswb-reg-v1` admits legacy
`66 [one optional REX.R/B] 0F 67 /r`, ModR/M.mod=3 and XMM0–15. The `67`
after `0F` is the opcode byte, not the address-size prefix. ModR/M.reg is the
destination and ModR/M.r/m the source. Read eight signed little-endian i16
words from the original destination, then eight from the original source; clamp
each independently to [0,255] and write the destination results into bytes 0–7
and source results into bytes 8–15. This is concatenated operand order, not
interleaved; a distinct source is preserved, and self-pack reads the original
aliased value before writing. SSE2 and CR0.EM=0, CR0.TS=0,
CR4.OSFXSR=1 are assumptions only.

Coverage includes `ffff` (-1), `8000` and `ff00` signedness sentinels;
0000/0001/007f/0080/00ff/0100/7fff clamp boundaries; all 65,536 i16 values in
each of eight positions for DEST and SRC against a widened reference; all
16×16 XMM/REX.R/B pairs, distinct order sentinels, self-aliasing, full-state
and source preservation, and zero data callbacks. Truncation, missing SSE state,
STOP/budget atomicity, strict decoder/schema negatives including VEX
`C5 F9 67 C1`, and a handwritten XMM8/XMM9 fixture cover boundaries. JIT and
native execution are denied. PACKSSDW, other pack/shuffle/shift operations,
memory, MMX, extra prefixes, REX.W/X, VEX/EVEX, feature gates, exception
delivery and physical execution remain excluded. S2-34, S2-35, global
`S2-35 → S2-34`, and combined Mac mini/SSH acceptance remain open. Evidence is
recorded in [STAGE_2_REPORT.md](../reports/STAGE_2_REPORT.md).

other/duplicate prefixes, VEX/EVEX, JIT/native admission and physical execution
remain outside this local slice. SSE2 availability and CR0/CR4 preconditions
are assumed; control-register gates and `#UD/#NM` delivery are not modeled.

Local verification covers every 128-bit truth-table position, all-zero,
all-one, alternating and upper/lower sentinels, identity/zero behavior, all
16×16 register pairs and independent REX.R/B extension, source preservation and
aliasing, full-state/no-data-callback behavior, missing SSE with seeded x87,
STOP/zero-budget/truncated-fetch atomicity, and strict MMX/sibling/memory/prefix
rejection. A handwritten high-XMM fixture exercises the interpreter and
remains denied by JIT and native execution. This child does not close S2-35,
S2-34, or their global dependency.

Parent S2-34 остаётся open; физический запуск `not_run`, ISSUE-012 остаётся открытой.


#### S2-34.23 — local-only MOVUPD base+displacement memory forms

Добавлен отдельный строгий schema-v2 профиль `s2-long-movupd-mem-base-v1` для long-mode `66 [one optional REX.R/B] 0F 10/11 /r`. Разрешены только memory ModR/M.mod=00/01/10 с обычной 64-bit GPR base и отсутствующим либо signed disp8/disp32. REX.R выбирает XMM0–15, REX.B — базовый GPR. SIB (`r/m=4`), mod=00/rm=5 включая REX.B, register ModR/M, REX.W/X, address-size override, segment/прочие malformed mandatory prefixes, scalar/VEX/EVEX формы закрыты. Старые точные `[RAX]` профили не расширялись. Парсер повторно использует `rm_operand` и `MemoryOperand`; выполнение наследует existing full canonical48 range validation и делает один 16-byte read/write с commit CPU только после успеха. Unaligned разрешён локально; arbitrary backend memory rollback не заявляется. RBP остаётся SS-attributed, R13 — DS/#GP-attributed.

Handwritten fixtures отдельно исполняют load `[R9+1]` (`66 45 0F 10 81 01 00 00 00`) и store `[R8-7]` (`66 45 0F 11 40 F9`), используют XMM8 и различимые raw bytes/canaries. Decode checks покрывают signed disp8 boundaries -128/+127, signed disp32 extrema и RBP/R13 fault attribution; validation rejects SIB, RIP-relative (including a runner regression where signed disp32 targets mapped data), prefix/REX violations, register mode and truncated displacement. Testkit callback checks observe one 16-byte data callback and injected load/store failures preserve CPU state. CLI interpreter fixtures pass; JIT returns `Unsupported`; native profile is denied.

Проверены `cargo test -p od-isa movupd --offline` (13), `cargo test -p od-testkit movupd_memory_base --offline` (2), `cargo test -p od-runner --test fixture_v2 local_movupd_memory_base --offline` (2, including mapped-data RIP-relative rejection), `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`, Linux `cargo check -p od-x86-runner --all-targets --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --offline`, `git diff --check` и `graphify update .`. Native denial compile-checked only; physical behavior `not_run`. Parent S2-34 remains open; ISSUE-012 remains open. См. [CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#local-profile-s2-3423-s2-long-movupd-mem-base-v1), [report](../reports/STAGE_2_REPORT.md#s2-3423--local-movupd-base-displacement-memory-profile), and [fixture notes](../../tests/fixtures/x86/stage2/README.md#s2-3423-local-movupd-memory-base-diagnostic-profile).

#### S2-34.24 — local-only MOVUPD RIP-relative memory forms

Добавлен отдельный строгий profile `s2-long-movupd-mem-rip-v1`: только long-mode `66 [optional REX.R only] 0F 10/11 /r`, ModRM.mod=00/rm=101 и disp32. REX отсутствует/40/44; REX.B, SIB и любые другие формы исключены. REX.R выбирает XMM0–15. Эффективный адрес — RIP после полной инструкции плюс signed disp32; длина 8 байт без REX и 9 с REX. Decoder использует `rm_operand`, а execution — общий `NextRip`/16-byte memory path. Предыдущие `[RAX]` и base+displacement профили остаются строгими.

Handwritten load/store cases покрывают REX.R, XMM8 и mapped target. Decoder и interpreter matrices проверяют all XMM registers, обе длины инструкции, signed disp32 extrema/negative/zero/positive offsets, точный callback address и полный 16-byte callback, canonical crossing, truncation, zero budget и stop before fetch. Testkit проверяет CPU commit только после успеха; runner asserts literal payload/canaries, interpreter output и JIT denial. Схемные negatives проверяют REX.B/X/W, SIB/base формы, префиксы, address32, VEX/EVEX и truncation. Существующие exact `[RAX]`, MOVUPD base и MOVUPS RIP профили проверены отдельно. Проверки и ограничение physical `not_run` зафиксированы в [отчёте](../reports/STAGE_2_REPORT.md#s2-3424--local-movupd-rip-relative-memory-profile); native denial compile-checked only, parent S2-34 и ISSUE-012 остаются open.


#### S2-34.25 — local-only MOVUPD SIB memory forms

Добавлен отдельный строгий профиль `s2-long-movupd-mem-sib-v1`: long-mode
`66 [optional one REX.R/X/B] 0F 10/11 /r`, ModR/M.mod=00/01/10, r/m=100 и
обязательный SIB. REX.W, address32, другие префиксы, non-SIB/register формы,
VEX/EVEX отвергаются. REX.R выбирает XMM, scale покрывает 1/2/4/8, индекс
R12 кодируется SIB.index=4 с REX.X=1; без REX.X index=4 означает отсутствие
индекса. Для mod=00/base=5 задаётся no-base + signed disp32 независимо от
REX.B; R13 как base допустим только при mod=01/10. RSP/RBP сохраняют SS
атрибуцию, а R12/R13/no-base — data.

`rm_operand`/`MemoryOperand` и существующая 16-byte read/write семантика
переиспользуются. Schema validator отдельно проверяет исходный класс
ModR/M/SIB; прежние `[RAX]`, base и RIP-relative MOVUPD profiles отвергают
SIB, даже если target data отображён. MOVUPS SIB остаётся в отдельном профиле
S2-34.6c и не изменялся этим добавлением. Детерминированная матрица decoder покрывает
обе операции, mod 00/01/10, четыре scale, отсутствие/обычные/расширенные
индексы и базы, SIB-special index/base значения, REX.R/X/B и XMM0–15. Fixtures
проверяют indexed load/store и base=5 no-base load/store с REX.B, raw payload,
canaries, callback width/address, injected backend errors, interpreter result и
JIT denial. Parent S2-34/ISSUE-012 остаются open; native denied, physical
`not_run`.

#### S2-40b. Узкий SSE-only native XORPD oracle

**Статус:** программный срез реализован и проверен; физический запуск
`not_run`. Родительские S2-26, S2-39, S2-40, S2-41 и S2-42 остаются открытыми.

Отдельный профиль `s2-long-native-xorpd-xmm0-xmm1-v1` требует ровно
`66 0F 57 C1`, `XMM0 := XMM0 XOR XMM1`, один retirement, stop RIP `entry+4`,
полные XMM0–15 и MXCSR `0x1f80`; x87 state запрещён. Linux x86_64 runner
перед инструкцией устанавливает только XMM/MXCSR через PTRACE_GETFPREGS и
PTRACE_SETFPREGS и проверяет readback; итоговые SSE и integer snapshots
снимаются отдельно. Это ptrace transport, а не guest FXSAVE image. Существующие
x87/SSE и FXSAVE профили остаются native-denied; JIT, C adapter и CPUID target
не меняются.

Проверки включают строгий schema/admission, два handwritten asymmetric fixture
с независимыми literal XMM0 ответами, portable codec/readback tests, interpreter
comparison и Linux x86_64 compile check. Ни один физический результат не
заявляется; hardware run остаётся в общем финальном Mac mini substage. Детали и
границы приведены в [CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#s2-40b--bounded-sse-only-native-xorpd-oracle),
[Linux profile report](../reports/STAGE_2_LINUX_PROFILE.md#s2-40b--ограниченный-sse-only-native-xorpd-oracle)
и [fixture notes](../../tests/fixtures/x86/stage2/README.md#s2-40b-native-xorpd-xmm0-xmm1).

#### S2-25b — mutable bounded CR4 OSFXSR/OSXMMEXCPT FP initialization

**Статус:** локальный interpreter-срез реализован и проверен; физическое
исполнение `not_run`.

`Cr4Profile::FpInitLong64V1` admits four CR4 values: fixed PAE=1 and only
OSFXSR/OSXMMEXCPT varying. `LongModeState::cr4=None` preserves legacy state;
unprofiled entry points fail closed on `Some(cr4)`. The exact composition is
FNINIT, MOV RAX,CR4, OR RAX,0x600, MOV CR4,RAX, XORPD XMM0,XMM1. CR0 and CR4
gates use current state. CR accesses require CPL0; locked CR4 moves raise #UD
after full fetch; the successful composition fixture requires initial CR0 base
(EM=TS=0); FNINIT uses current CR0.EM/TS; XORPD checks EM/OSFXSR for #UD
before TS for #NM. SSE2 is assumed and OSXMMEXCPT is preserved without #XM
modeling. Strict schema, six fixture cases, output/comparator tamper checks and
interpreter/JIT/native-denial paths are recorded in the [CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#s2-25b--mutable-cr4-osfxsrosxmmexcpt-in-bounded-fp-initialization)
and [report](../reports/STAGE_2_REPORT.md#s2-25b--mutable-bounded-cr4-osfxsrosxmmexcpt-fp-initialization). No
CPUID, paging/TLB/CR3, JIT/native/C/fragment admission or physical result is
claimed. Normative source: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2B MOV CR/XORPD, Vol. 2A
FNINIT and Vol. 3A §5.10.4.1/Table 16-1 ([official SDM index](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/articles/technical/intel-sdm.html)).

#### S2-25d — mapped main-kernel IA32 EFER access; read-only candidate

**Статус:** documentary source/image mapping complete. Runtime implementation is recorded separately as S2-25e.

Map the `RDMSR IA32_EFER` site at `ffffffff8139c1b4` and conditional `WRMSR`
at `ffffffff8139c1d5` in `common_startup_64`, including the SCE/NXE changes and
the target CPUID.NX branch. Record that the compressed 32-bit EFER access is

and `__pi_*` helper paths are not exhaustively audited. The adjacent compiled
CR0 value `0x80050033` includes AM; the bounded S2-25a synthetic base

The next implementable CPU slice, if approved by evidence review, is a
read-only exact Long64 `RDMSR` for IA32_EFER at ECX=`0xc0000080`, supplied by
an explicit immutable profile value. A candidate synthetic domain is
`0x500`, `0x501`, `0xd00`, `0xd01` (fixed LME/LMA, independently selected SCE
and NXE); none is claimed as the observed Ubuntu entry value. Keep `WRMSR`,
mode transition, NX page enforcement and paging effects outside that bounded
slice; Stage 4 owns system-level effects. Do not add an inert EFER field or a
general MSR map.

**Критерии:** (1) exact source/package/ELF mapping and conditional flow are
recorded; (2) observed bytes, architectural requirements and synthetic policy
are separated; (3) LMA/paging effects and the CR0 AM discrepancy are explicit;

#### S2-25e — exact read-only Long64 RDMSR IA32_EFER

**Статус:** bounded local interpreter and schema-v2 fixtures implemented;

#### S2-38h. Exact Long64 MAXSD XMM0,XMM1 unmasked invalid and denormal exit

The interpreter-only schema-v2 profile `s2-long-maxsd-unmasked-denormal-v1`
admits only Long64 `F2 0F 5F C1`, one executable code mapping, budget 1 and
stop RIP `entry+4`. It has its own immutable `MaxsdUnmaskedControls` snapshot
for SSE2 availability, CR0.EM/TS and CR4.OSFXSR/OSXMMEXCPT; the result echoes
that object. Complete fetch precedes SSE2/EM/OSFXSR #UD and then TS #NM checks;
only after those gates are low qwords XMM0/XMM1 classified. CPL0–3 follow the
same gate sequence. Reserved MXCSR bits, DAZ and FTZ must be clear; ZE/OE/UE/PE
masks must be set; IM, DM, RC and existing sticky bits may vary.

MAXSD-specific Rev. 093 Vol. 2B pp. 4-11–4-12 evidence governs its selector and
exception list. Finite operands select the numeric maximum. Either NaN, equal
values and signed-zero ties select raw source 2; source-2 SNaN/QNaN sign and
payload remain unchanged. The profile records raw subnormal classification.
For NaN+subnormal with both IM/DM masked, invalid priority adds IE only and
completes. If either relevant exception is unmasked, IE|DE are sticky and one
#XM (OSXMMEXCPT=1) or #UD (OSXMMEXCPT=0) occurs. Faults preserve all XMM0/RIP
and retire zero; completion changes only XMM0's low qword. Existing masked
MAXSD/MINSD execution is unchanged. JIT/native/C/fragment and physical admission
remain closed; no handler continuation is modeled.

The 88 fixed JSON inputs include the full QNaN/SNaN/subnormal/mixed operand
position × IM × DM × OSXMMEXCPT matrix, finite/equal/signed-zero/infinity
selectors, and pre-existing IE/DE without a new event. Independent schema-v2
result validation uses raw classification and its own ordering rule, validates
state/retirement/exception/control echoes, and rejects tampering. Two focused
ISA tests cover the complete input/control and prerequisite/fetch/budget/form
matrices; the runner integration consumes all 88 fixtures and checks JIT/native
denial. Sources: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2B MAXSD pp. 4-11–4-12
([official PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671241), SHA-256
`a261998ace8e07f624bf3e2486bb6cfe950fb8be8d0dc9631bcecb4c5ec953e4`); Vol. 1
§§4.9.2, 11.5.2.1–2, 11.5.3.2–3
([official PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671436)); Vol. 2A
Table 2-20. See the [CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#s2-38h--exact-maxsd-unmasked-invalid-and-denormal-exit),
[fixture format](../testing/TEST_CASE_FORMAT.md#s2-38h-exact-maxsd-unmasked-imdm-profile),
and [fixture notes](../../tests/fixtures/x86/stage2/README.md#s2-38h-local-maxsd-unmasked-invalid-and-denormal).


#### S2-38i — exact Long64 MINPD XMM0,XMM1 unmasked invalid and denormal exit

The interpreter-only schema-v2 profile `s2-long-minpd-unmasked-denormal-v1`
admits only Long64 `66 0F 5D C1`, one executable code mapping, budget one, and
stop RIP `entry+4`. Immutable profile controls record SSE2 availability,
CR0.EM/TS, CR4.OSFXSR and CR4.OSXMMEXCPT and are echoed in the result. Complete
fetch precedes SSE2/EM/OSFXSR #UD and then TS #NM; lane classification follows
only after those gates, at any CPL. MXCSR reserved bits, DAZ and FTZ are clear;
ZE/OE/UE/PE masks are set; IM, DM, RC and existing sticky flags may vary.

Both XMM operands are snapshotted and both binary64 lanes are precomputed using
`Binary64::min_sse_raw_result`. Raw IE/DE conditions are collected for both
lanes before deciding whether to commit. If any newly detected event is
unmasked, all detected IE/DE conditions are ORed into sticky status, a single
#XM or #UD is reported, and the entire destination XMM plus RIP are preserved
with zero retirement. If no detected event is unmasked, invalid suppresses DE
only within its own lane; lane results, aggregated IE/DE and the complete XMM
commit atomically. Source-2 NaN bits, equal values and signed-zero ties follow
the raw MIN selector. Existing masked MINPD remains unchanged.

The 128 handwritten schema-v2 fixtures cross lane0/lane1 raw event classes
{none, I, D, I+D} with IM, DM and OSXMMEXCPT; 16 supplemental literals cover
QNaN/SNaN positions and payloads, masked source-2 selection, signed-zero ties,
equal values, infinities and pre-existing sticky flags. Focused ISA coverage adds both
operand positions, swapped lane combinations, split and same-lane events, CPL,
full-state preservation and zero data-memory callbacks. Independent fixture
validation uses raw IEEE-754 bit classification and separate ordering logic.
JIT/native/C/fragment admission and physical execution remain closed. Sources:
Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2B MINPD pp. 4-16–4-18
(https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671241); Vol. 1 §§4.9.2, 11.5.3.1–3
(https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671436). See the [CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#s2-38i--exact-minpd-unmasked-invalid-and-denormal-exit), [fixture format](../testing/TEST_CASE_FORMAT.md#s2-38i-exact-minpd-unmasked-imdm-profile), and [fixture notes](../../tests/fixtures/x86/stage2/README.md#s2-38i-local-minpd-unmasked-invalid-and-denormal).


#### S2-38j — exact Long64 MAXPD XMM0,XMM1 unmasked invalid and denormal exit

The interpreter-only schema-v2 profile `s2-long-maxpd-unmasked-denormal-v1`
admits only Long64 `66 0F 5F C1`, one executable code mapping, budget one and
stop RIP `entry+4`. Immutable profile controls record SSE2 availability,
CR0.EM/TS, CR4.OSFXSR and CR4.OSXMMEXCPT and are echoed in the result. Complete
fetch precedes SSE2/EM/OSFXSR #UD and then TS #NM; lane classification follows
only after those gates, at any CPL. MXCSR reserved bits, DAZ and FTZ are clear;
ZE/OE/UE/PE masks are set; IM, DM, RC and existing sticky flags may vary.

Both XMM operands are snapshotted and both binary64 lanes are precomputed using
the MAXPD raw selector. Raw IE/DE conditions are collected for both lanes before
commit. If any newly detected event is unmasked, every raw IE/DE condition is
ORed into sticky status, one #XM or #UD is reported, and full XMM0/RIP remain
unchanged with zero retirement. Otherwise, masked invalid suppresses denormal
only within its own lane, then the complete XMM result and aggregated status
commit atomically. MAXPD selects SRC2 for either NaN (including forwarding SRC2
SNaN bits unchanged) and for equal values; both signed-zero operands select
SRC2. Other non-NaN values select SRC1 only when SRC1 is strictly greater.
Existing masked MAXPD remains unchanged.

The 128 handwritten schema-v2 fixtures cross lane0/lane1 raw event classes
{none, I, D, I+D} with IM, DM and OSXMMEXCPT. Sixteen supplemental literal
fixtures cover QNaN/SNaN on either operand side with payload/sign preservation,
both zero ties, equal finite values, infinities, a max-vs-min discriminator,
subnormals and pre-existing sticky status. Focused ISA tests cover the complete
control gate matrix, CPL0–3, partial fetch, budget/STOP, exact-form rejection,
full-state preservation and no data-memory callbacks. The independent fixture
validator classifies raw NaN/subnormal bits and uses its own MAX ordering rule.
JIT/native/C/fragment admission and physical execution remain closed. Sources:
Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2B MAXPD pp. 4-5–4-7
(https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671241); Vol. 1 §§4.9.2,
11.5.3.1–3 (https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671436). See the [CPU
contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#s2-38j--exact-maxpd-unmasked-invalid-and-denormal-exit),
[fixture format](../testing/TEST_CASE_FORMAT.md#s2-38j-exact-maxpd-unmasked-imdm-profile),
and [fixture notes](../../tests/fixtures/x86/stage2/README.md#s2-38j-local-maxpd-unmasked-invalid-and-denormal).


#### S2-38k — exact Long64 MINPS XMM0,XMM1 unmasked invalid and denormal exit

The interpreter-only schema-v2 profile `s2-long-minps-unmasked-denormal-v1`
admits only Long64 `0F 5D C1`, one executable code mapping, budget one and stop
RIP `entry+3`. Immutable controls record SSE availability, CR0.EM/TS,
CR4.OSFXSR and CR4.OSXMMEXCPT and are echoed in the result. Complete fetch
precedes the SSE/EM/OSFXSR #UD and then TS #NM gates; lane evaluation follows
only after these gates at any CPL. MXCSR reserved bits, DAZ and FTZ are clear;
ZE/OE/UE/PE masks are set; IM, DM, RC and old sticky flags may vary.

Both XMM operands are snapshotted and four binary32 lanes are evaluated before
exception disposition. MINPS forwards raw SRC2 for either QNaN/SNaN, equal
values and signed-zero ties, preserving SNaN bits. Raw IE/DE are collected
across all lanes. An unmasked event ORs every discovered IE/DE bit into MXCSR,
reports one #XM or #UD as selected by OSXMMEXCPT, preserves full XMM0/RIP and
retires zero instructions. Masked completion suppresses DE only in a lane that
also has IE, then commits the complete XMM result. Existing masked MINPS is
unchanged.

Sixteen literal lane/control anchors and sixteen selector/status anchors are
executed through schema-v2. Focused ISA tests cover all 2048 combinations of
four lane classes `{none, I, D, I+D}` and IM/DM/OSXMMEXCPT, gate/fetch/form
precedence, CPL0–3, budget/STOP, full-state suppression and no data callbacks.
The independent validator classifies raw binary32 bits and uses its own MIN
selector. JIT/native/C/fragment admission and physical execution remain closed.
Sources: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2B MINPS pp. 4-19–4-21
(https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671241); Vol. 2A Table 2-19
(https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671199); Vol. 1 §§4.9.2,
11.5.3.1–3 (https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671436). See the [CPU
contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#s2-38k--exact-minps-unmasked-invalid-and-denormal-exit),
[fixture format](../testing/TEST_CASE_FORMAT.md#s2-38k-exact-minps-unmasked-imdm-profile),
and [fixture notes](../../tests/fixtures/x86/stage2/README.md#s2-38k-local-minps-unmasked-invalid-and-denormal).

#### S2-37s — canonical Long64 CVTDQ2PS XMM register pairs

The local profile `s2-long-cvtdq2ps-registers-v1` implements all 256 canonical
Long64 XMM destination/source pairs. It accepts `0F 5B /r`, ModR/M.mod=3, and uses
exactly REX `41`/`44`/`45` for the high source/destination extensions. An
independent parser derives the operands and variable length, checks a single
executable mapping, budget one, and overflow-checked stop RIP. Other prefixes,
REX classes, memory, trailing bytes, VEX and EVEX are local profile refusals.
The earlier conversion profiles remain separate and unchanged.

The interpreter snapshots the whole source XMM, converts its four signed dword
lanes directly to binary32 under MXCSR.RC, aggregates only new Precision into
sticky PE, and preserves all other MXCSR bits. Unmasked inexactness commits PE
before #XM/#UD and suppresses all destination lanes, RIP advancement and
retirement. Masked/exact operations commit all lanes; old PE alone does not
fault. Full fetch precedes SSE2/EM/OSFXSR #UD gates and the TS #NM gate at
CPL0–3; no data memory callbacks occur. MXCSR input is restricted to
`0x0000ffbf`; FTZ has no effect. JIT/native/C/fragment/generic CPUID
admission remain denied.

The independent validator computes lane bits with an integer oracle and
separately aggregates each lane's inexact flag. The runner exercises 256 pairs,
all aliases and 512 cases spanning all lane masks × RC × PM × OSXMMEXCPT × old
PE. Literal vectors include signed 2^24 neighborhoods, ties, directed rounding,
i32 endpoints and zero; lane 3 alone inexact verifies atomic destination
suppression. Prerequisite/CPL/fetch/no-callback, malformed/stop/tampering and
JIT/native denial checks passed. Focused checks passed:
`cargo test -p od-testkit cvtdq2ps_prerequisites_fetch_order_and_cpl_matrix_make_no_data_callbacks --offline` and
`cargo test -p od-runner cvtdq2ps_register_pairs_and_precision_exception_matrix --offline`.
Other checks and review status are recorded in the stage report. This bounded
register profile leaves m128 alignment/address/page faults, other modes,
physical acceptance, and the S2-37/S2-38 parents open.

Sources: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2A CVTDQ2PS pp. 3-211–3-213; §2.5.2,
Table 2-19 p. 2-27; Vol. 1 §§11.5.3.1–3; REX §2.2.1.2/Table 2-4
([official PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671199)). See the
[CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#s2-37s--canonical-long64-cvtdq2ps-xmm-register-pairs),
[report](../reports/STAGE_2_REPORT.md#s2-37s--canonical-long64-cvtdq2ps-xmm-register-pairs), and
[fixture notes](../../tests/fixtures/x86/stage2/README.md#s2-37s-canonical-cvtdq2ps-register-pairs).

#### S2-37t — canonical Long64 CVTSS2SD XMM register pairs

Implement schema-v2 interpreter profile `s2-long-cvtss2sd-registers-v1` for
all 256 Long64 XMM destination/source pairs. Accept only `F3 0F 5A /r` for low
registers and canonical `F3 41`, `F3 44`, or `F3 45` before the opcode when an
extended source and/or destination is used. Require ModR/M.mod=3, one
executable mapping, budget one, and checked `entry+length` stop RIP. Other
prefixes (including redundant REX 40, W/X, extra/reordered prefixes), memory,
trailing bytes, VEX and EVEX are profile refusals. Older profiles remain
unchanged.

Snapshot source XMM before any destination write. Widen only low binary32 to
binary64, preserve destination high64, and ignore source high96. Exact zero,
normal and infinity conversions add no flags; QNaN preserves sign/payload,
SNaN quiets and raises new IE, and binary32 subnormal widens exactly and raises
new DE. OR new IE/DE into existing sticky status. An unmasked new event commits
that status before #XM when OSXMMEXCPT=1 or SIMD-generated #UD otherwise, while
suppressing destination, RIP advance and retirement. Existing IE/DE alone do
not fault. DAZ and reserved MXCSR bits refuse the local profile; RC and FTZ do
not affect conversion. Full fetch precedes SSE2/EM/OSFXSR #UD, TS #NM, and the
post-fetch type-3 gate; no data memory callbacks occur.

Coverage includes all register pairs/self aliases, binary32 classes and each
of the 23 subnormal leading-bit positions, ignored source high96 and preserved
destination high64, IE/DE × masks × OSXMMEXCPT × old sticky, JIT/native denial,
and malformed forms. Prerequisite/CPL/fetch/no-callback and result-tampering
checks are in the focused ISA and runner tests. JIT/native/C/fragment admission,
generic CPUID, memory operands, other modes, full S2-34/38, Stage 4, and physical
acceptance remain open. Source basis: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 1 Table D-11,
Table 11-1, §§11.5.2.2, 11.5.3.1–3 and Vol. 2A CVTSS2SD pp. 3-240–3-241,
Tables 2-15 and 2-20.

#### S2-37u — canonical Long64 CVTPS2PD XMM register pairs

Implement schema-v2 interpreter profile `s2-long-cvtps2pd-registers-v1` for
all 256 XMM destination/source pairs. Accept canonical bare `0F 5A /r` for low
registers and exactly `41`, `44`, or `45` REX before the opcode for extended
source and/or destination. Require ModR/M.mod=3, one executable mapping, budget
one and checked stop RIP `entry+length`. Redundant `40`, W/X, memory, mandatory
prefixes, trailing bytes, VEX and EVEX are profile refusals only. Preserve prior
profiles.

Snapshot source before either lane is converted. Read only source low64, widen
two binary32 values exactly to two binary64 lanes, and replace the entire
128-bit destination, including aliases. QNaN mapping adds no IE; SNaN is quieted
and raises IE; a binary32 subnormal widens exactly and raises DE. Aggregate new
IE and DE independently across lanes and preserve all other MXCSR bits. An
unmasked new event commits applicable sticky bits, suppresses the whole
destination/RIP/retirement, then reports #XM or SIMD #UD by OSXMMEXCPT. Old
sticky flags alone do not fault. No PE/OE/UE/ZE; RC/FTZ are irrelevant; DAZ is
refused. SSE2/EM/OSFXSR #UD and TS #NM gates run after full fetch at CPL0–3.

The independent schema parser derives both registers and length; the oracle
parses source bits and reuses its integer-only scalar widening oracle separately
for both lanes. Coverage includes 256 pairs/16 aliases, all 288 combinations of
per-lane none/IE/DE events, IM, DM, OSXMMEXCPT and old IE/DE; NaN payload/sign,
all subnormal leading positions, ignored high64 hostile values, whole-destination
replacement/suppression, prereq/fetch/no-callback, malformed bytes, tampering,
JIT/native denial. Memory m64, other forms/modes, generic CPUID integration,
physical acceptance, and parent S2-37/S2-38 remain open.

Sources: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2A CVTPS2PD pp. 3-228–3-230, Tables 2-15 and
2-20 p. 2-28; Vol. 1 Table D-11 and §§11.5.3.1–3. See the [CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#s2-37u--canonical-long64-cvtps2pd-xmm-register-pairs), [report](../reports/STAGE_2_REPORT.md#s2-37u--canonical-long64-cvtps2pd-xmm-register-pairs), and [fixture notes](../../tests/fixtures/x86/stage2/README.md#s2-37u-canonical-cvtps2pd-register-pairs).

#### S2-37v — canonical Long64 COMISS and UCOMISS XMM register pairs

Implement the strict schema-v2 interpreter-only profile
`s2-long-comiss-ucomiss-registers-v1` for both `0F 2F /r` COMISS and
`0F 2E /r` UCOMISS across all 256 XMM pairs. Accept canonical bare 3-byte
forms for low registers and exactly REX `41`, `44`, or `45` 4-byte forms when
either operand is extended; require ModR/M.mod=3, one executable mapping,
budget one and checked stop RIP. The independent parser derives opcode,
operands and length. Other prefixes, REX `40`/W/X, memory, trailing bytes,
VEX and EVEX are profile refusals. Keep existing profiles unchanged.

Snapshot both XMM operands and consume only low32. Classify raw binary32 bits;
both signed zeros compare equal. COMISS raises new IE for QNaN or SNaN;
UCOMISS raises it only for SNaN. If either input is NaN, suppress new DE from
the other input. Otherwise either subnormal raises new DE. OR new sticky IE/DE
into MXCSR. An applicable unmasked event updates sticky status first, then
reports #XM or SIMD #UD according to OSXMMEXCPT while preserving full RFLAGS,
RIP and retirement. On completion, unordered sets ZF/PF/CF, greater clears
them, less sets CF, equal sets ZF; clear OF/SF/AF and preserve other flags and
definedness. Full fetch precedes SSE/EM/OSFXSR #UD then TS #NM at CPL0–3.
MXCSR reserved bits and DAZ are refused; RC/FTZ are irrelevant.

The independent schema oracle parses opcode and raw source bits without the
production comparison helper. Cover all 512 encodings, both operand orders,
QNaN/SNaN and subnormal priority, infinities, signed zero, adjacent normals,
exception-mask/OSXMMEXCPT/old-sticky combinations, ignored high96, fault atomicity,
gates, fetch, CPL, tampering and backend denial. Do not claim memory forms,
generic CPUID admission, physical validation, or completion of parent S2-37.
Sources: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2A COMISS pp. 3-201–3-202; Vol. 2B UCOMISS
pp. 4-735–4-736; Vol. 1 Tables D-6/D-7, §4.9.2, §§11.5.2.2/11.5.3.


#### S2-37w — canonical Long64 COMISD and UCOMISD XMM register pairs

Implement schema-v2 interpreter-only profile `s2-long-comisd-ucomisd-registers-v1` for `66 0F 2F /r` COMISD and `66 0F 2E /r` UCOMISD across all 256 XMM pairs. Low pairs use canonical 4-byte encodings; extended pairs use `66 41/44/45 0F opcode`, ModR/M.mod=3 and length 5. Reject REX.W/X, redundant or reordered prefixes, memory, trailing bytes, VEX and EVEX. Snapshot both registers and read low64 only; preserve all XMM state. COMISD signals IE for QNaN/SNaN, UCOMISD for SNaN only. NaNs suppress new DE from the other operand; absent NaNs either subnormal raises DE. Apply sticky status before #XM or SIMD #UD; only new unmasked events fault. Faults preserve full RFLAGS/RIP and retirement; success sets ZF/PF/CF by comparison and clears OF/SF/AF while preserving other bits. Require SSE2, !EM, OSFXSR before TS; CPL0–3. Refuse DAZ/reserved MXCSR bits; RC/FTZ are irrelevant. JIT/native/generic/C/fragment admission remains closed. The macOS hardware acceptance portion remains deferred to the final combined stage.

#### S2-37ab — canonical Long64 CVTSS2SI register space

Implement schema-v2 interpreter-only profile `s2-long-cvtss2si-registers-v1`
for 512 canonical `F3 0F 2D /r` (`r32`) and `F3 REX.W 0F 2D /r` (`r64`)
register forms: every GPR destination × XMM source. Require ModR/M.mod=3.
REX.R extends the GPR destination and REX.B extends the XMM source. Admit only
canonical REX encodings, reject REX.X, memory, redundant/reordered/other prefixes,
trailing bytes, VEX and EVEX as local profile refusals. The complete instruction
must be fetched before SSE/EM/OSFXSR #UD then TS #NM gates; gates have the same

independent schema oracle parses raw binary32 bits and performs its own integer
rounding/classification; it must not call production `Binary32::to_i32/to_i64`.

zero-extended 32-bit result to the full GPR. Preserve source XMM, all other XMMs,

#### S2-37aj — canonical Long64 SQRTSS XMM register pairs

Implement strict schema-v2 interpreter-only profile `s2-long-sqrtss-registers-v1` for all 256 canonical Long64 XMM destination/source pairs: `F3 0F 51 /r`, ModR/M.mod=3. Extended indices require exactly REX `41`, `44`, or `45` immediately after F3; low-register forms use length 4 and extended forms length 5. Reject memory, REX.W/X/40 (including redundant bare REX), duplicate/reordered prefixes, trailing bytes, VEX and EVEX. Keep JIT/native/C/fragment and generic dispatch closed.

DAZ and reserved MXCSR bits may be refused; all four RC modes, FTZ, six exception masks and sticky bits are accepted. For DAZ=0, positive subnormal input raises precomputation DE; a masked DE allows computation to continue and may add postcomputation PE. A negative nonzero input (including negative subnormal and negative infinity) takes SQRTSS's terminal invalid-result path: it raises IE only, does not also consider DE even when IM masks IE, and produces the Intel indefinite `0xffc00000` when masked. SNaN is quieted and raises IE; QNaN passes without IE under the local raw helper's sign/payload-preserving policy. Do not claim a hardware-specific NaN payload policy. Positive finite inexact results raise PE and follow MXCSR.RC. FTZ does not affect this result domain because every positive finite square root is normal.

Commit sticky flags before unmasked SIMD #XM when OSXMMEXCPT=1 or SIMD-generated #UD otherwise. SQRTSS invalid negative inputs take the terminal IE path and do not also report DE; for positive subnormals, unmasked DE stops before computation, so no PE is committed. Unmasked PE is postcompute. Every unmasked outcome preserves destination, RIP and retirement. Full instruction fetch precedes SSE/EM/OSFXSR #UD and TS #NM at CPL0–3; this profile issues no data callbacks. Use an independent raw-u32 integer-square-root oracle, covering all register pairs, RC, input classes, pre/post exception ordering, masks/stickies, gates, atomicity, malformed encodings, result tampering and backend denial. Memory forms, other execution modes, physical acceptance and parent S2-37/S2-38 remain open. Sources: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2B SQRTSS pp. 4-669–4-670; Vol. 1 §4.9.2 and §§11.5.2.1–.2, 11.5.3.1–.2; Vol. 3A Table 7-8; Floating-Point Reference Sheet v2.13, pp. 1–2.

Implement strict schema-v2 interpreter-only profile `s2-long-sqrtps-registers-v1` for all 256 canonical Long64 XMM destination/source pairs: `0F 51 /r`, ModR/M.mod=3. Reject `66`/`F2`/`F3`, other/redundant/reordered prefixes, REX.W/X/40, memory, trailing bytes, VEX and EVEX. Keep JIT/native/C/fragment and generic dispatch closed. Reject DAZ and reserved MXCSR bits, accept all RC modes, FTZ, exception masks and prior sticky bits. Full fetch precedes SSE/EM/OSFXSR #UD and TS #NM at CPL0–3; no data callbacks occur. #### S2-37an — bounded masked-range Long64 SUBPD XMM register pairs

Implement strict schema-v2 interpreter-only profile
`s2-long-subpd-registers-v1` for canonical Long64 `66 0F 5C /r`, ModR/M.mod=3,
covering all 256 XMM destination/source pairs. Low forms are four bytes;
extended indices require exactly one REX `41`, `44`, or `45` immediately after

prefixes, REX.W/X/40, trailing bytes, VEX and EVEX. Fetch the complete encoding
